brief:
Israeli forces have blockaded Madama, a West Bank village, with roadblocks that prevent residents from accessing hospitals and schools, Al Jazeera English reported. Villagers described being unable to reach medical facilities and educational institutions, disrupting essential services for the community.

The blockade has also restricted access to olive groves, affecting residents' livelihoods and agricultural activities. Madama residents said the roadblocks have effectively isolated the village from surrounding areas.
dek: Residents of Madama describe being cut off from hospitals, schools, and olive groves as Israeli forces blockade village.
title: Israeli roadblocks cut Madama village off from schools and hospitals
